errors.text: The proposed intervention omits the target 4.2 at.% Cr addition and instead uses cold rolling and partial recrystallization.
It excludes Laves-phase formation as an embrittlement risk, whereas the target mechanism requires approximately 4 vol.% reticulated Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase.
The baseline room-temperature ductility is incorrectly stated as below 5%; the target as-cast HfMoTaTiZr baseline has approximately 11.6% compressive fracture strain.

The claimed density reduction is not tied to a specified, tested composition: grain-structure processing cannot materially lower intrinsic density, and the falsification experiment retains the equiatomic composition rather than testing the proposed Mo/Ti optimization.
